verdict.rationale: Activepieces flows pair a trigger with actions and run on their own once published, and agents briefed in plain language handle work as it arrives, including recurring jobs like "every morning" (docs-21, docs-39, docs-40, docs-37, docs-8). Durable execution resumes interrupted runs from their last checkpoint, and approval gates are optional, so autonomous background operation is clearly documented (docs-9, docs-42). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of schedule/polling/webhook trigger types and their unattended execution guarantees, and independent hands-on corroboration that background runs work reliably.
